meta.name: vercel-cli
meta.description: Deploy apps to Vercel. Use when asked to deploy, ship, or publish a web application, or manage Vercel projects, domains, and environment variables.

copy.tagline: 把网页应用发布到 Vercel，管理域名和环境变量
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果 你经常要把网站部署到 Vercel 并管理其设置
copy.tagline_en: Deploy web apps to Vercel and manage domains and env vars
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you regularly deploy websites to Vercel and manage their settings.

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 会用 vercel 命令行把网页应用部署到 Vercel,并在把链接给你之前先跑本地构建、确认部署状态和线上地址能打开;也能管理 Vercel 项目、域名和环境变量。
howto.when: 当你要求部署、发布网页应用,或要管理 Vercel 的项目、域名、环境变量时触发;每次操作前它会先跑 vercel whoami 检查授权。

say.note: 会先本地构建,再部署并验证链接

say.note: 返回最近的部署列表与状态

say.text: 把 Vercel 上的环境变量拉到本地 .env
say.note: 执行 vercel env pull 写入本地

howto.what_en: After install, Claude deploys web apps to Vercel with the vercel CLI, and before sharing the link it runs the local build, checks deployment status, and verifies the live URL responds. It can also manage Vercel projects, domains, and env vars.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask to deploy, ship, or publish a web app, or to manage Vercel projects, domains, or environment variables; it runs vercel whoami first to check auth.

say_en.text: Deploy this project to Vercel production

Lists recent deployments and their status
